why: Six legitimate pre-kickoff artifacts exist for 2026-08-13 and each pins its own pre-start market consensus, but the earliest kickoff is 2026-08-13T23:00Z — nothing has been observable yet. A post-event file can never masquerade as pre-event evidence, so the settlement waits for reality rather than reconstructing it.

trigger.condition: the sport-schedules cadence (13:00Z) lands the Aug 13 finals in app/public/data/nfl/results/latest.json with STATUS_FINAL and integer scores
trigger.automatedBy: .github/workflows/nfl-event-window.yml (settle job, cron 30 14 * * *) — the manual command is the fallback, not the plan

acceptance: each of the six events settles EXACTLY ONCE: a second run adds no rows and the receipt's canonicalEventId set is unchanged
accounting reconciles with gap zero — artifactsForDate === settled + pending — or the script refuses to write at all
every settled event carries full lineage: the artifact file it graded, its generatedAt, the market capturedAt, the evidence stamps, and the settlement contract version
pushes and voids are reported separately from the decisive denominator (WIN + LOSS); a missing or non-final result stays PENDING and is never a loss
the receipt states plainly that it grades the PRE-START MARKET consensus, not model performance — the team model abstained in preseason
protected money is untouched: portfolio.json md5 stays affe6b21071f2b3be96bb2774eb347c3
knownRisks: the CAR@ARI precedent: a final without pre-event schedule lineage is quarantined, never settled — these six have lineage in two committed captures
postponement or abandonment yields VOID_PENDING_REVIEW, not a loss
a score correction after settlement appends correction lineage; nothing regrades silently (docs/NFL_CORRECTIONS_RUNBOOK.md)
